title: ÆON capability profile
description: The capability profile an ÆON runtime establishes before it offers or relies on any capability-dependent behaviour (protocol/capabilities.md, CAP-1 and CAP-5). A flag is true only after the agent has verified the capability in the current session. Anything else is false: unverified, undeterminable and inconclusive all record as false (CAP-3, CAP-9), because an unavailable capability named honestly is conformant while a claimed one is a violation (CAP-4). A profile is corrected mid-journey when a capability stops working (CAP-10), so it is a live record, not a one-time declaration.

capabilities.title: Verified capability flags
capabilities.description: The result of capability detection, re-established per session and corrected whenever a capability changes (CAP-10). All ten canonical keys are present, spelled exactly as in CAP-1, because sibling specifications, schemas and evals reference them literally. A runtime MAY add further flags for capabilities the protocol does not name (CAP-2), but MUST NOT redefine the ten.

web_research.description: The agent can retrieve and read live web content in this session. False forces disclosure of the research limitation and lowered confidence claims instead of fabricated sources (RES-3, EPI-6).

persistent_memory.description: The agent can store learner state and recall it in a later session. False means the agent says so and emits a resumable state block instead (STA-6).

scheduled_tasks.description: The agent can schedule future or recurring runs, such as daily session delivery. Only a true value licenses the separate recurring-delivery offer (CAP-8, LEARN-C-10).

proactive_notifications.description: The agent can contact the learner without being prompted first.

audio_generation.description: The agent can produce audio output, such as a generated podcast episode. False degrades the podcast renderer to its script (REN-3).

text_to_speech.description: The agent can synthesise speech from text, the second route to an audio rendering.

file_generation.description: The agent can create files the learner keeps outside the conversation.

presentation_generation.description: The agent can generate slide files. False degrades the presentation renderer to an outline (REN-3).

image_generation.description: The agent can generate images, for example a concept map at completion.

code_execution.description: The agent can execute code in this session, for example to run a learner's exercise.

propertyNames.description: Capability keys are ASCII lower snake case, like the ten canonical names. This encodes the repository's identifier convention, not an additional protocol requirement.

additionalProperties.description: An extension capability flag (CAP-2) with the same semantics as the canonical keys: true only after verification in this session.

$comment: The top level stays open on purpose: a capability profile is rarely a document of its own. It travels inside a larger carrier — an eval case's simulated_context (evals/learn/cases/), a learner state, a runtime's own session record — and closing the top level would reject those legitimate carriers while adding nothing, because the constraint that matters lives in the capabilities object.
